proposal.expected_benefit: This change will ensure that the audit integrity requirement is clearly addressed and enforced, preventing any misinterpretation or bypass of the audit anchor, thereby strengthening the overall security posture.
proposal.problem: The mitigation 'Clarify audit and compliance enforcement' does not explicitly address the requirement for audit integrity, which is explicitly stated in the scenario.
proposal.proposed_change: Update the mitigation strategy to explicitly address the requirement for audit integrity, ensuring that audit integrity is not only a condition but also a mandatory enforcement point in the system. This includes adding a specific mitigation to enforce audit integrity as a non-negotiable requirement, separate from compliance enforcement.
proposal.title: Enhance Audit Integrity Requirement Clarification
verification_tests: Verify that the updated mitigation explicitly addresses audit integrity as a mandatory requirement.
Confirm that the audit integrity enforcement is not overridden by compliance decisions.
